question: You and three colleagues are archaeologists tasked with selecting a site to salvage crucial artifacts before construction begins. There are tight time constraints: you can only pick one location, and you must choose by the end of the hour. There are three candidate sites: Site A, Site B, and Site C. You must maximize your chances of a successful recovery, as failure means the artifacts may be lost forever.
